name: MULTIVERSO Arts Festival
description: Catch the final days of this dynamic festival celebrating performance art, with a packed schedule of cinema, theatre, and artist talks. It's a fantastic free opportunity to dive into the city's contemporary creative scene.
longDescription:
The MULTIVERSO Arts Festival is an annual event showcasing contemporary performance art, organised by a collective of local artists and cultural institutions in Porto. Its aim is to provide a platform for emerging and established artists working across various disciplines, fostering dialogue and engagement with new artistic expressions. The festival focuses on interdisciplinary works, exploring the boundaries between different art forms.

Visitors to MULTIVERSO can expect a varied programme of live performances, film screenings, and discussions with artists. The atmosphere is generally one of curiosity and intellectual engagement, attracting an audience interested in contemporary art and experimental forms. Events are held within the historic Palácio do Bolhão, a grand architectural setting in the heart of the city, which provides a formal backdrop to the modern artistic presentations.

Admission to all festival events is free. As the festival approaches its conclusion, walk-ins are welcome for most events, though specific capacity limits may apply to smaller venues within the palace. The Palácio do Bolhão is centrally located, a 5-minute walk from Bolhão metro station and easily accessible by various bus lines.
